top_choice_rationale: P001 is a mature, complete discovery chain from proglucagon processing and the incretin effect through human GLP-1 physiology and the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide to therapies with confirmed glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The three-person allocation (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is separable and defensible under a citation centred on physiology and the active form of the hormone, so a prize this year is preferable to no award.
